page.overview:
What is God Valley Incident?

God Valley was an island in the West Blue unaffiliated with the World Government, where the so-called God Valley Incident took place 38 years ago. The island has since disappeared without a trace, having sunk beneath the ocean following the eponymous incident.

It is notably the birthplace of Shanks of the Four Emperors and his twin brother, Saint Figarland Shamrock. In addition, the island is the birthplace of Rocks D. Xebec and was a safe haven for the Davy Family, including Rocks' son, Marshall D. Teach.

The island was characterized by tall, steep cliffs and canyons. Its most distinct landmark was a tall rock formation that was vertically split in the middle, forming one vast, valley-like ravine. This ravine ran northwest to southeast. According to the World Nobles, the island was abundant in natural resources.

The island had at least one town, which followed the conventions of and was situated within the ravine.
